sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday. The leaders arrive in excellent form with a recent sequence of W-D-W-W-W, though they will be heavy favourites against a struggling Alsager side that sit bottom with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could have title-race implications given the narrow gap at the top; Stafford showed resilience with a recent draw after a loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third on the table, host Eccleshall in a clash between two strong sides—Bridgnorth have been excellent lately with five wins in their last six, while Eccleshall have recovered from a recent loss with an earlier winning run. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in a meeting of mid-table sides, with Casuals showing mixed recent form (W-W-D-W-L-W) against Wednesfield's inconsistency (W-L-W-L-L-W). Bilston Town, fifth in the standings, host Foley Meir—both sides have shown decent recent form with Bilston particularly solid. New Mills welcome Market Drayton Town; New Mills have struggled recently with two losses in their last three outings, while Market Drayton offer limited threat from ninth place. Shawbury United face Barnton at home after a disastrous five-game losing streak, though Barnton themselves have been patchy with mixed recent results. Brereton Social host Widnes Town in a fixture between two lower-half sides; Widnes arrive pointless and winless with a dire streak of five losses, while Brereton show modest form with a recent win. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a battle near the bottom; Telford's recent stretch of four consecutive defeats offers little encouragement, while Nomads' recent draw suggests slight stability. Finally, Crewe host Allscott Heath—Crewe are desperately seeking wins after a difficult run, while Allscott have shown some recent improvement with two wins in their last three matches.
